blocks.text: Working title: nothing yet. Roughly nine shots, none of them frightening

on their own.

A door left open. A hand setting down a cup. A road at the wrong time of
day. A person seen from behind, not turning. The dread is entirely in the
cutting — no score, no reveal, nothing to point at afterwards and say

*that* was the scary part.

If the Kuleshov thing is true, it will work. If it does not work, I will
have learned that it is not true, which is also worth twenty-eight
